dict.string: Hildegard uses your camera only when you tap Record in the Studio or press Go live or Show a preview, to record yourself for a film or so viewers can see you. Recordings stay on this computer, and nothing is streamed until you press Go live.

Hildegard uses your microphone only when you tap Record in the Studio or press Go live, to record your voice for a film or so viewers can hear you. Recordings stay on this computer, and it streams only while you are live.
Hildegard captures your screen when you go live or show a preview, so viewers can see it. Nothing is captured until you ask.
